meta.title: Lucia Adams

services.label: Sites

work.title: Work
work.intro: Three projects in production. For each one: what you see, and the machine driving it.

pulpina.name: Pulpiña RD
pulpina.alt: Pulpiña RD home page with its three stores: Moon, Sunshine and Men
pulpina.summary: An alternative fashion store in the Dominican Republic, with three sub-brands sharing one catalog.
surface: Moon, Sunshine and Men: each line with its own palette, mascot and storefront.
A full identity drawn for the store, from the logo to each universe's badges.
Type, color and components built around the brand's personality.
systems: One inventory and three storefronts: each product is tagged once and shows up where it belongs.
The cart builds the order and hands it off over WhatsApp with an order number, where people already buy.
New and Sale badges plus birthday discounts driven by rules, not by hand.

stemise.name: STEMise
stemise.alt: STEMise home page with its headline, navigation and calls to action
stemise.summary: The platform for a youth-led STEM education nonprofit active in more than 30 countries.
surface: A simple visual system that works the same for students across 30+ countries.
Kits, curriculum, volunteering and donations: every visitor finds their path in one click.
Two clear calls on the home page: get kits or see the curriculum. Nothing competes with that.
systems: A donation channel fiscally sponsored by Hack Club, ready to receive funds from day one.
The request and delivery flow behind 150+ STEM kits donated to students.
An open curriculum organized by primary, middle and high school.

togethersport.name: Together Sports
togethersport.alt: Together Sports home page with its motto Play Loud. Build Strong. and program photos
togethersport.summary: A youth sports nonprofit running four programs under a single brand.
surface: Play Loud. Build Strong. carried into giant type, color and rhythm.
Real photos from the programs, not stock: the site feels like the practices do.
Each sport with its own color and graphics, held together under one brand.
systems: Tennis, basketball, football and golf: each sport gets its own section without duplicating the site.
Donate, volunteer or sign up: every visitor leaves the home page with a next step.
Second Serve: a used-equipment donation flow with partner Rally Forward NYC.
